editorialRules: Mark schematic models as schematic; do not label them experimental measurements.
Do not present rhizophagy hypotheses as established universal processes.
Do not infer exact nutrient deficiencies or pathogens from isolated symptoms.
Do not claim fixed stage VPD optima without crop-specific controlled evidence.
Do not claim certification until identity, grading, persistence, and print verification pass.
